extends.label: Extends
extends.help: A base profile: this profile inherits its interfaces, data points and files and lists only what it adds or changes.
extends.chainHelp: Inherited items show where they come from. Change one to override it here, or mark it as not present.

unused: Changes to items the base no longer has are ignored: {{items}}

aliases.label: Known as
aliases.help: Names tools commonly use for this data point, such as a gateway's variable names. Imports of data collections match them.

additions.title: Added on this asset
additions.help: Data points and interfaces of this asset alone. They count as delivered like the profile's data points.
